rules.description: Applicant must be resident in England
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for England residents only. Scotland and Northern Ireland have separate schemes.

rules.description: Applicant must be State Pension age OR have a qualifying disability
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have reached State Pension age or have a qualifying disability to apply

rules.description: Applicant must reside within a local authority boundary in England
rules.reason_if_failed: We need to confirm which local authority you belong to

rules.description: Applicant must not already have an active bus pass
rules.reason_if_failed: You already have an active bus pass. Contact your local authority to replace a lost or damaged pass.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is under State Pension age but has a qualifying disability
edge_cases.action: Route to disability assessment pathway. Evidence required: PIP award letter, blue badge, or medical certification.

edge_cases.description: Applicant resides in Scotland or Northern Ireland
edge_cases.action: Redirect to respective national scheme. Scotland/NI passes available from age 60.

edge_cases.description: Applicant's address falls on local authority boundary
edge_cases.action: Manual review required to determine correct issuing authority.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is temporarily in England but permanent resident elsewhere
edge_cases.action: Pass only valid for permanent England residents. Handoff to council for case-by-case assessment.
